Ben Stokes Retires from International Cricket Amidst Test Match

England Test captain Ben Stokes has announced his retirement from international cricket. The decision comes during the ongoing Test match against New Zealand, which will be his final game. Stokes, who has had a distinguished career, stated the retirement was a personal decision made at the right time to maintain his love for the game.
